task_completion.description: The Weasis medical viewer is launched and visible on the screen.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Weasis application window is open, showing the user interface and toolbars.

task_completion.description: The DICOM image is loaded into the main viewer area.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A medical image (DICOM) is displayed in the central viewport of Weasis.

task_completion.description: The agent accesses the spatial calibration tool or menu.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A calibration dialog box, context menu, or tool setting for 'Calibrate' or 'Spatial Scale' is visible.

task_completion.description: The agent sets the pixel scale based on a 50 mm reference.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Input fields in a calibration dialog showing '50' and 'mm' being entered or applied to a drawn reference line.

task_completion.description: A 50 mm horizontal measurement overlay is placed across the center of the image.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A horizontal line tool is visible across the center of the image with a text label indicating '50 mm' (or very close to it).

task_completion.description: The agent uses the export/save function to save the view as a JPEG.
task_completion.visual_evidence: An 'Export' or 'Save As' dialog is visible with the format set to JPEG and the path pointing to /home/ga/DICOM/exports/calibrated_scale.jpg.

integrity.description: The agent used the Weasis GUI to perform calibration rather than command-line manipulation of the DICOM header.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with Weasis menus and drawing tools.

integrity.description: The 50mm measurement is a real overlay in the software, not a text box manually placed to hide an incorrect scale.
integrity.visual_evidence: The measurement line has the standard Weasis UI styling (e.g., handles at ends, specific font style).

integrity.description: The agent did not simply move a pre-existing image to the export path using the terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: The export process is visible within the Weasis application interface.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The target measurement value is exactly 50 mm. The final exported file must be a JPEG located at /home/ga/DICOM/exports/calibrated_scale.jpg. The calibration must be performed on a horizontal line across the center of the image.
